# Shulenest

> Shulenest is a CBC (Competency-Based Curriculum) school management system for
> Kenyan schools. It runs the whole school day in one place — assessments and
> reports, fees, attendance, timetables and parent messaging — and works on any
> phone, including offline.

Shulenest is web-based (works in any browser) and installs as an app on Android
and other phones. It is designed specifically for Kenya's CBC, from Pre-Primary
(PP1) through Senior School (Grade 12), with learning areas seeded from the
Ministry of Education catalogue.

## What it does

- **CBC assessments and reports**: teachers enter marks by class, learning area
  and assessment; competency levels (Exceeding, Meeting, Approaching, Below
  Expectation) are derived automatically. Class broadsheets, Excel exports, and
  printable report forms on the school's own letterhead.
- **School fees**: itemised fee structures by vote head (Tuition, Transport,
  Lunch, etc.), a live register with per-learner balances, partial and irregular
  payments, and M-Pesa payment against a learner's admission number. Report
  forms carry the fee balance and next term's fee.
- **Attendance**: the class teacher marks a daily register; the head teacher and
  deputy see a monthly calendar. Present, absent, or health leave per learner.
- **Timetables**: automatic, conflict-free timetable generation across the
  school with teachers assigned to the periods they teach.
- **Bulk messaging**: SMS and WhatsApp notices to parents — the whole school,
  one class or stream, or only families with a fee balance — with a recipient
  preview and per-family merge fields before sending.
- **Parent portal**: parents sign in with their child's admission number or UPI
  and see the child's profile, assessments, fee balance and school notices.
- **Offline-first**: score entry and registers save on the device without a
  connection and sync automatically when it returns.
- **Staff and administration**: staff register, streams and learning areas per
  grade, a task/duty hub, and a document filing cabinet for the school.

## Who uses it

- Teachers — score entry, schemes of work, lesson plans, their timetable,
  their class register.
- Office and bursar — admissions, fees and receipts, bulk parent messages,
  the school profile and documents.
- Head teacher and deputy — whole-school performance analysis, scheme approval,
  duty assignment, fees and attendance across grades.
- Parents — their own child's records and the school's notices.

## Privacy

Each school's data is fully isolated from every other school on the platform.
A parent can see only their own children. Uploaded files (photos, documents,
report cards) are served through private, expiring signed links, never a public
directory.

## Access

- Web app and login: https://shulenest.com/login
- Android APK: https://shulenest.com/shulenest.apk
- Country: Kenya. Curriculum: CBC (Competency-Based Curriculum).
- Contact: hello@shulenest.com
